items.title: Carrick joins Wilcox under the bus after Manchester United’s latest night in crisis | Max Rushden
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes followed Lisandro Martínez in revolt after his team’s 4-1 defeat to Como in the Champions League You have to credit Manchester United. Your local rivals have turned the Premier League into an almost meaningless farce. We are questioning the validity of anything we’ve seen over the past 20 years; wondering how many goals Erling Haaland will get in the Championship. We are looking at the league table from second position down and wishing we’d invested in inflatable bananas a month ago. And yet here comes the Old Trafford machine: from players to the captain to the manager to the director of football, to the director of the director of football, to a minority owner who feels the UK is being “colonised by immigrants”, to debt-leveraging majority owners who take vast sums out of the club and are collectively saying hold my Ineos-sponsored high-performance wellness immune boost smoothie. items.title: Bruno Guimarães had sleepless nights before Newcastle exit but hopes for same ‘love’ at Arsenal
items.summary: Midfielder says there were a lot of tears as he said goodbye at St James’ Park but he is enjoying the remorselessness at his new club For Bruno Guimarães, it was a time to show his steeliness, to fix his eyes on the prize – even if he knew it would surely mean them welling up. And then some. It was a tumultuous summer for the Brazil midfielder. A fine World Cup on a personal level was marred by a crucial penalty miss in the last-16 loss against Norway. Now he had the dream move lined up to Arsenal but it could not happen without breaking some hearts at Newcastle. Guimarães admits he lay awake at night as the emotions swirled. How could he leave Newcastle, the club where he made so many connections and enjoyed so many highs after joining from Lyon in January 2022? There were the Champions League qualifications and, above all, the Carabao Cup triumph in 2025 that ended a 70-year wait for a domestic trophy. On the other hand, how could he resist Arsenal and the prospect of competing regularly for the game’s top honours? Continue reading...

items.title: Champions League review: PSG take a hit, Man City’s empty seats and teenage hope for Liverpool
items.summary: The reigning champions must deal with the absence of Khvicha Kvaratskhelia for some time, while fans at Anfield were thrilled by Rio Ngumoha Paris Saint-Germain beat Barcelona 4-2 on Tuesday, but the reigning champions lost the best player in last season’s tournament, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia. This autumn has seen much lobbying for the Ballon d’Or, with the Georgian a popular choice, despite his absence from the World Cup. He is expected to be out for six months, although Rodri’s comeback from serious injury – he was rested by Barcelona on Tuesday until coming off the bench in the 60th minute – shows it can take far longer than that for players to rediscover their highest level. items.title: Nottingham Forest’s false start places early focus on Glasner and Delap
items.summary: Austrian’s tactics need adapting to but Forest are in the bottom three and their owner is not the patient type Sitting 19th in the Premier League was not the plan for Nottingham Forest after the arrival of a highly acclaimed manager and a £45m striker to fuel their ambitions. The fates of Oliver Glasner and Liam Delap are intertwined and with the stark stats of zero home goals and a solitary point at the City Ground it is not the dream start they were aiming for. As Delap prepares to return to Ipswich, where his career ignited, on Friday night, Forest are remaining calm. There is a desperation to get away from the short-termism that caused so many problems; 12 months ago, they were on their third head coach of a disappointing season. This summer they were ruthless with the removal of Vítor Pereira, who had done a fine job to escape the drop, because they saw an opportunity to upgrade with Glasner, hoping he could transform Forest like he did Crystal Palace. Continue reading...

items.title: Harry Kane admits wait to learn if he has won Ballon d’Or is ‘very stressful’ for family
items.summary: Bayern Munich and England striker is odds-on favourite ‘I try not to think about it. Obviously it is hard not to’ Harry Kane would love to know now whether he has won the Ballon d’Or because the uncertainty and constant questions are driving his family to distraction. But the Bayern Munich and England striker accepts the suspense before the big reveal at the London Palladium on Monday night is part of the show. Kane is the odds-on favourite to win the prestigious individual honour after a prolific run of form. The 33-year-old scored 61 goals for Bayern last season and 12 for England. This time out, he has 10 for Bayern and six for England. He scored from the penalty spot in Wednesday night’s 2-2 Champions League draw against Arsenal at the Allianz Arena, although his stand-out moment was the inch-perfect through ball that set up Alphonso Davies to make it 1-1. Continue reading...

items.title: Klopp waarschuwt Club Brugge-sensatie Tresoldi met duidelijke uitspraak

items.title: Toby Alderweireld encense un cadre du Club de Bruges : "C'est un exemple pour beaucoup"
items.summary: Joaquin Seys a une nouvelle fois impressionné ce mercredi soir avec le Club de Bruges. Le jeune défenseur s'est montré particulièrement actif face au RC Lens et a même inscrit un but lors de la victoire des Blauw en Zwart (3-0). Une prestation qui n'a pas échappé à Toby Alderweireld. L'ancien Diable Rouge s'est directement adressé au jeune Brugeois en direct à la télévision et n'a pas tari d'éloges sur sa progression et son travail.

items.title: Genk grijpt in om goudhaantje langer vast te kunnen leggen
items.summary: KRC Genk wil Aaron Bibout de komende jaren verder zien doorgroeien. De Limburgers hebben het contract van de 22-jarige aanvaller aangepast, waardoor de club hem nu ook een optie geeft om de samenwerking tot medio 2031 te verlengen. Bibout lag al vast tot 2030, maar Genk onderstreept met die extra optie het vertrouwen in zijn verdere ontwikkeling.

items.title: Voormalige Duitse international onthult spijt na tattoo-onthulling: "Ik speel nooit meer voor Duitsland"
items.summary: Kerem Demirbay heeft spijt van zijn keuze om voor Duitsland uit te komen. De middenvelder, die tegenwoordig in Turkije bij Kasimpasa speelt, blikt in een interview met journalist Yagiz Sabuncuoglu terug op zijn internationale carrière. Vooral één detail blijft hem achtervolgen: de tattoo op zijn rug die zijn Turkse afkomst symboliseert. Volgens Demirbay veranderde er iets nadat die zichtbaar werd tijdens een wedstrijd voor Duitsland.
